request.prompt:
Production hand-drawn animation sheet, EXACTLY 24 consecutive cels in SIX columns and FOUR rows. Output 3072x2048, one 512x512 cel at each template location. Read left-to-right, then next row. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, no drawn labels, guides, lines, crosses, circles, background, floor or furnace.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1) First image is a GEOMETRIC LAYOUT TEMPLATE. Use its cell boundaries, centers, and increasing circle radii as strict placement guides. Replace every outlined guide circle with the animated painted strokes; the guide itself MUST NOT appear. Center of each cell is (256,256). All effects fit strictly within that cell's circular guide. The first cel is tiny, last cel nearly fills the cell with ample margin. Keep the same fixed camera, ground plane scale, and origin in all 24 cels. No automatic per-cell fitting.
2) Second image is a six-pose MOTION STUDY only, showing short commas growing tails, bending and forking. Spread and refine that development over the beginning and middle of this new 24-cel animation. Do not copy its incorrect occupied sizes.
3) Third image is the mature final pose and design reference. Final cel should closely match its curved cyan/gold strips, diamonds and two hollow marks, at radius220 in the template. It defines the END of the action only, not a tiny starting circle. Ignore its halo/background completely.

Draw the BIRTH AND EXPANSION of an arcane ground effect in Don't Starve Together hand-drawn ink style: four muted cyan and three antique gold separate strokes develop into long curved hooked strips, accompanied later by a few small icy diamonds and two purple hollow angular marks. Orthographic top-down circular layout, not an ellipse. Simple color planes, dark tapered irregular contour, sparse painted inner bright strokes. No photoreal shading, no neon bloom.

ROW 1, frames1–6: nearly empty first frame, then seven tiny separated short comma strokes emerge near center. Gradually heads bend clockwise, tails lag, tiny C curls open into asymmetric S curls. At frame6 they are still short young curved dashes. No mature long blades, no diamonds or purple marks yet. This row's effect radii are 12,22,32,42,53,64 pixels, exactly as template. All blank space must remain transparent.
ROW 2, frames7–12: strokes flow out on curved clockwise paths. Head widens first, narrow tail catches up, each curve opens and changes its centerline. Uneven small tail forks grow gradually; length increases faster than width. Inner highlight changes from dot to curled dash to split long stroke. The short C shapes become long loose hooks. Only tiny diamond seeds begin in last two frames. Radii75,86,97,108,119,130.
ROW 3, frames13–18: strips lengthen and open into mature scythe-like curved strokes, tangential tips swing clockwise as the body drifts outward. New fork branches become pronounced, curved bright interiors stretch and split. Thin and thick sections develop independently. Diamond seeds unfold into angular bright chips, purple hollow marks emerge gradually. Main strip identity and color order remain recognizable; don't randomly swap shapes. Radii141,152,162,172,182,191.
ROW 4, frames19–24: outward movement slows into the final pose. Long cyan and gold strips flex, tails swing and settle with a little lag, visible notches and curved highlight shapes continue to evolve. End near the mature third reference, same color order and visual identity. Radii199,206,212,216,219,220. Last two drawings should differ only slightly as the motion eases.

CRITICAL: These 24 cells are 24 original, individually drawn consecutive shapes, NOT resized copies of a ring. The stubby starting commas must develop long tails, irregular forks, changed curvature and reshaped highlights. The animation should clearly show EACH STRIP turning, stretching and flowing outward independently. Never make a completed ring at the start and merely enlarge it. Maintain continuous positions and stable centers from cell to cell. No rigid mechanical rotation of the entire picture. No frame labels, no cell lines, no visible guide circles. Each cell has authentic transparent empty margins, central hole and all gaps.
